Global_Suspicious_IP_Watchlist: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS domainName,domainId AS 'Domain', QIDNAME(qid) AS 'Event Name', logsourcename(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source', sourceIP AS 'Source IP', destinationIP AS 'Destination IP', destinationPort AS 'Destination Port', SUM(eventCount) AS 'Event Count', DATEFORMAT(startTime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time', CATEGORYNAME(category) AS 'Low Level Category', sourcePort AS 'Source Port', userName AS 'Username' FROM events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}' AND ( referencesetcontains('Global-Suspicious IP-Watchlist', destinationIP) AND destinationPort>'0' ) GROUP BY domainId, qid, logSourceId, sourceIP, destinationIP, destinationPort START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}'
Global_Suspicious_Domain_Watchlist: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS domainName,domainId AS 'Domain', QIDNAME(qid) AS 'Event Name', logsourcename(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source', sourceIP AS 'Source IP', destinationIP AS 'Destination IP', destinationPort AS 'Destination Port', URL AS 'URL (custom)', "URL domain" AS 'URL domain', SUM(eventCount) AS 'Event Count', DATEFORMAT(startTime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time', CATEGORYNAME(category) AS 'Low Level Category',sourcePort AS 'Source Port', userName AS 'Username' FROM events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}' AND ( ( referencesetcontains('Global-Suspicious URL-Watchlist', URL) OR referencesetcontains('Global-Suspicious URL-Watchlist', "URL domain") ) AND destinationPort != '53' ) GROUP BY domainId, qid, logSourceId, sourceIP, destinationIP, destinationPort, URL, "URL domain" START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}'
Global_Suspicious_Hash_Watchlist: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS domainName,domainId AS 'Domain', QIDNAME(qid) AS 'Event Name', "Source Hostname" AS 'Source Hostname (custom)', logsourcename(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source', "File Hash" AS 'File Hash (custom)', "MD5 Hash" AS 'MD5 Hash (custom)', "SHA1 Hash" AS 'SHA1 Hash (custom)', "SHA256 Hash" AS 'SHA256 Hash (custom)', SUM(eventCount) AS 'Event Count', DATEFORMAT(startTime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time', CATEGORYNAME(category) AS 'Low Level Category', sourcePort AS 'Source Port', userName AS 'Username' FROM events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}' AND ( ( ( referencesetcontains('Global-Suspicious Hash-Watchlist', "File Hash") OR referencesetcontains('Global-Suspicious Hash-Watchlist', "MD5 Hash") ) OR referencesetcontains('Global-Suspicious Hash-Watchlist', "SHA1 Hash") ) OR referencesetcontains('Global-Suspicious Hash-Watchlist', "SHA256 Hash") ) GROUP BY domainId, qid, "Source Hostname", logSourceId, "File Hash", "MD5 Hash", "SHA1 Hash", "SHA256 Hash" START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}'
